Eligibility of Tenderer : This invitation for Tender is open to Enlisted ( Electrical) Contractor / Supplier of Rajuk or Other Govt./ Semi Govt./
Autonomous Organization/ Reputed Bona Fide Firm as mentioned below as further detailed in the Tender Data Sheet
(TDS) as well as Particular Conditions of Contract (PCC) of the Tender Document.
(a) The Tenderer having minimum 05 ( Five) years general experience of Electro--Mechanical / CCTV / PABX System
Supply & Installation works .
(b) The Tenderer shall have successfully Completed CCTV / PABX / Similar nature Servicing & Maintenance Work in a
single or two Contracts minimum amount Tk. 34.00 (Thirty four) Lac within last 05 ( Five) years Under in Govt./ Semi
Govt./ Autonomous body. i.e Counting backward from the date of publication of IFT in the News Paper/ Website.
(c) The minimum amount of Liquid Assets or Working Capital or Credit Lines of the Tenderer shall be Tk. 45.00 (Forty
five) Lac only.
(d) Annual Electro - Mechanical Turnover : Last five years ( Financial year 2019-2020, 2020-2021 , 2021-2022, 2022-2023,
2023-2024 ) Average Annual Turnover should be required minimum Amount Tk. 40.00 (Forty) Lac.
(e) Tenderer must have up-to-date ABC Category Contractory & Electrical Supervisory License from Bangladesh
Electrical Licensing Board.
(f) The Tenderer must have Income Tax clearance Certificate (2023-2024).
(g) The Tenderer must have VAT/BIN Registration Certificate.
(h) The Tenderer must have valid Trade License (2024-2025)
